platform.name: macOS
platform.previewLimitation: Native SwiftUI metadata only; no HTML/CSS components or shadow-DOM previews exist. No CSS detector applies to this app.

nativeColors.purpose: Warnings/pending changes, additions, removals; paired with text or symbols.

nativeTypography.title: Font.title2 + semibold
nativeTypography.body: Font.body; medium for entry names and backup timestamps
nativeTypography.note: macOS resolves sizes, leading, and system font family; no fixed replacement sizes.

entryRow.height: Intrinsic vertical height; minimum inner height 40 points
entryRow.symbolAlignment: Vertically centered beside the name and caption subtitle
entryRow.textStructure: Medium-weight name and caption subtitle, both single-line with middle truncation

fixedRegions: Validation above a single row of right-aligned bottom actions
importTable.destination: Separate Import as column beside the action menu; editable only for Rename, secondary text for other actions, em dash for Skip
importTable.entry: Original name and quiet kind caption without an icon

nativeEffects.depth: System window/sheet depth, semantic surfaces, native controls and dividers; no custom shadows.
nativeEffects.motion: No app-defined motion tokens; system control behavior.
nativeEffects.colorRamps: Omitted: adaptive OS colors have no project-defined tonal ramps.
nativeEffects.focus: Native SwiftUI/AppKit focus, selection, hover, pressed, and disabled rendering.

components.name: Prominent action
components.description: Apply uses glass in the toolbar; creation and sheet confirmations stay bordered. Native states and sizing.

components.name: Utility action
components.description: Add, refresh, and file-chooser actions retain native help and accessibility labels. Detail headers use circular glass icon buttons.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Shared across contexts, clusters, users, and backups, with explicit clear and no-match states.

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Configuration and History groups, native selection, and SF Symbols.

components.name: Grouped editor
components.description: Platform-owned form rows, text fields, and pickers. Credentials use plain text fields.

components.name: Detail header
components.description: Semibold title2 with glass icon actions.

components.name: Notice bar
components.description: Vertically centered symbol, wrapping callout, optional actions, and adaptive tint.

components.name: Review diff
components.description: Selectable monospaced callout text, change prefixes, semantic status colors, native sheet actions.

components.name: YAML editor
components.description: Monospaced editor with syntax colors, a line-number gutter, and a parse error marker.

nativeImplementation.pattern: NSViewRepresentable wrapping NSTextView with an NSRulerView

components.name: Import review
components.description: Aligned Entry, Status, Action, and Import as table with contexts first, fixed headings and footer, and scrollable rows. No summary counts. Short native menus default to Add for new entries and Reuse for identical entries. Rename edits the destination inline beside its menu; other actions show secondary destination text, with an em dash for Skip. Replacement warnings, validation, and resolved paths remain; no imported-YAML preview.

nativeImplementation.pattern: ImportSheet: HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 16); flexible Entry, Status width 95, Action width 120, Import as width 225; native menu Picker and inline conditional rounded-border TextField; 12-point vertical row padding; content-sized sheet capped at 580 points; right-aligned buttons share one footer row; dividers only between entries

components.name: Entry row
components.description: Vertically centered section symbol beside a medium-weight name and caption subtitle. Intrinsic vertical sizing and a minimum inner height preserve both text lines when inserted.

nativeImplementation.pattern: EntryRow: HStack(spacing: 10) with VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 5); .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true).frame(minHeight: 40); list applies .padding(.vertical, 5)

narrative.northStar: A familiar, compact macOS configuration editor
narrative.overview:
KubeConfig uses standard macOS controls, Liquid Glass chrome, system typography, compact spacing, and automatic light/dark appearance. The visual priority is quick inspection and careful editing of a local configuration, with familiar navigation and explicit review before writing to disk.

SwiftUI and AppKit own control rendering, keyboard focus, selection, materials, and adaptive type. SF Symbols identify sections and actions. The generated blue hexagonal cluster icon with white configuration sliders is the app identity asset; its artwork does not define a fixed interface palette.
keyCharacteristics: Adaptive macOS colors and semantic system type.
Native controls and SF Symbols, with glass reserved for chrome.
Actions that never move: Undo, Discard, and Apply stay in the toolbar.
Visible draft state and reviewable changes.

rules.name: The Adaptive Color Rule
rules.body: Preserve the source semantic color references; never promote sampled light/dark colors into fixed interface tokens.

dos: Do use semantic SwiftUI/AppKit colors and verify both macOS appearances.
Do preserve native focus, keyboard shortcuts, disabled states, and accessible action labels.
Do keep search available for contexts, clusters, users, and backups, including clear-search and empty-result states.
Do pair warnings and diff colors with symbols, text, or change prefixes.
Do distinguish selection, active context, and pending changes in labels and affordances.
Do keep every action reachable by more than right-click: a toolbar or header button, a menu item, or a shortcut.
donts: Don't freeze screenshot RGB values or system type sizes into brand tokens.
Don't replace standard macOS controls with custom web or mobile imitations.
Don't use the app icon's blue as a mandatory interface accent; retain Color.accentColor.
Don't introduce decorative shadows, display fonts, or ornamental panels into the compact workspace.
Don't put glass on forms, list rows, or code surfaces.
